## AttributeFilterTransformer() function

Decorator that transforms attribute filter to corresponding class instances. Needed for transformation of attribute value filter.

Transforms attribute value between these formats:

JSON:

```json
{
 "attr::test_prop::value": "test_value"
}
```
Class:

```json
{
 "attributeValue": {
   "name": "test_props",
   "value": "test_value"
 }
}
```

<b>Signature:</b>

```typescript
export declare function AttributeFilterTransformer(): PropertyDecorator;
```
<b>Returns:</b>

PropertyDecorator

## Example

class Example { AttributeFilterTransformer() public attributeFilter?: AttributeFilter; }
